inputs.name: recordValue.value
inputs.description: Candidate Jev response value passed to recordValue. It is accepted only when it is a non-null object that is not an array.

inputs.name: probabilityValue.value
inputs.description: Candidate Jev probability passed to probabilityValue. It must be a finite number from 0 through 1, inclusive.

inputs.name: tokenCount.value
inputs.description: Candidate Jev usage count passed to tokenCount. It must be a nonnegative safe integer.

outputs.name: recordValue
outputs.description: The accepted response object returned unchanged as a string-keyed record. Its value must be a non-null, non-array object.

outputs.name: probabilityValue
outputs.description: The validated probability returned unchanged as a number. It is finite and within the inclusive range 0 through 1.

outputs.name: tokenCount
outputs.description: The validated usage count returned unchanged as a number. It is a nonnegative safe integer.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: recordValue throws this Error for null, non-object, or array inputs; probabilityValue throws it for non-numbers, non-finite numbers, or values outside 0 through 1; tokenCount throws it for non-numbers, non-safe integers, or negative values. The respective messages are "Invalid Jev response", "Invalid Jev probability", and "Invalid Jev usage".

inputs.name: recordValue.value
inputs.description: Candidate Jev response value passed to recordValue. It is accepted only when it is a non-null object that is not an array.

outputs.name: recordValue
outputs.description: The accepted response object returned unchanged as a string-keyed record. Its value must be a non-null, non-array object.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown when value is null, is not an object, or is an array; the message is "Invalid Jev response".

inputs.name: probabilityValue.value
inputs.description: Candidate Jev probability passed to probabilityValue. It must be a finite number from 0 through 1, inclusive.

outputs.name: probabilityValue
outputs.description: The validated probability returned unchanged as a number. It is finite and within the inclusive range 0 through 1.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown when value is not a number, is not finite, or is outside the inclusive range 0 through 1; the message is "Invalid Jev probability".

inputs.name: tokenCount.value
inputs.description: Candidate Jev usage count passed to tokenCount. It must be a nonnegative safe integer.

outputs.name: tokenCount
outputs.description: The validated usage count returned unchanged as a number. It is a nonnegative safe integer.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown when value is not a number, is not a safe integer, or is negative; the message is "Invalid Jev usage".
